data.title: 雨夜共伞的半步距离
data.location: 霓虹与路灯倒映的雨夜归途街角
data.lighting: 暖橙路灯与冷青霓虹湿地倒影
data.camera: 黑伞伞沿前景肩并肩近中景
data.prompt: 1girl, solo, shiki_natsume, tailored long black wool coat, amber plaid scarf, black leather gloves, standing close beneath shared black umbrella, shoulder nearly brushing viewer, gloved hand steadying umbrella handle, looking sideways with slight blush and dry expression, falling night rain, black umbrella canopy foreground, warm amber streetlamp glow, cool cyan neon puddle reflections on dark street, medium shot
data.animaCaption: Stepping half a pace closer beneath the shared black umbrella in her tailored black wool coat and amber scarf, she steadies the handle with a gloved hand while pretending not to notice how close your shoulders have drawn. Warm streetlamp gold and cyan neon rain reflections dance across the wet night street behind her.
data.promptProse: Composed closely under the dark ribbed canopy of a shared black umbrella on a wintry rainy evening, Shiki Natsume walks half a step closer than necessary in a long tailored black wool coat, amber plaid scarf, and sleek leather gloves. Resting one gloved hand on the umbrella handle next to yours, she glances sideways with a deadpan look belied by the soft flush above her scarf while rain streaks through golden streetlamp beams and reflects cyan neon across the glistening dark pavement.
data.story: 冬夜的冷雨打在黑伞面上沙沙作响。夏目戴着皮手套握紧伞柄，嘴上还在嫌弃这把伞实在太小，肩膀却不知不觉往你这边多靠了半步——「肩膀湿了一半别怪我……往里站一点，笨蛋。」
